workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked the complete list of availabilities you sent for Elena and David against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. I can confirm that there are no overlapping free slots. Our analysis from both sides shows that all four partners are never free at the same time next week.

This means we cannot schedule the meeting. I'm prepared to report this as infeasible, but I want to confirm with you one last time before I do. Please let me know if you agree.
